name: The Creators of Kustomazi
lore_description: Kasutamaiza the Customizer and his devout Servants, heralds of genesis who shaped the quiet void into a seed to birth Planet Kustomazi.
playstyle_overview: Tribute and Fusion summoning centered on high-stat DIVINE Divine-Beast deities and void recursion.

name: The LeSpookiest Night
lore_description: Born from the dimensional rift left by the shaping of Planet Kustomazi, the LeSpookies inhabit a counterworld of Toontastic sights where lovers of Halloween awaken their inner supernatural spirits under glowing streetlights.
playstyle_overview: Gemini and Trick-or-Treat Counter strategy transitioning costumed Normal mortals into supernatural Effect, Synchro, and Link evolutions.

name: The Spellspires
lore_description: The first order founded upon Planet Kustomazi: a team of brilliant alchemists gifted a piece of the primordial void by Kasutamaiza to study, dissect, and create arcane magic with.
playstyle_overview: Alchemical Fusion arts and spellbook transmutations (Alchemical Bonds), weaving void essence into ascended Fusion forms.

name: The Counsel of Time
lore_description: A revered assembly of dimensional manipulators entrusted by Kasutamaiza to govern and balance the phases of time, taught ancient ritual arts.
playstyle_overview: Ritual Summoning, temporal phase control, dimensional manipulation, and turn-pacing disruption.

name: The Teeming Fields of Springtime
lore_description: A lush collective of diverse plant and insect beings created to populate the new world, cultivating flourishing vegetation, life, and ecological vitality across Planet Kustomazi.
playstyle_overview: Swarm field presence, Plant/Insect token generation, nature-based resource ramp, and ecological swarming.

name: The Snares
lore_description: A cunning reptilian fiend race guided directly by Kasutamaiza in the tactical arts of trap setting, perimeter defense, and the unyielding enforcement of celestial rule and order.
playstyle_overview: Continuous Trap control, counter-punishment, Reptile/Fiend tactical disruption, and lock-down mechanics.

name: The Hidden Treasures
lore_description: Gem-infused beasts questing deep within the subterranean mines of Planet Kustomazi to uncover the ultimate source of energy for the world: The Hidden Treasure.
playstyle_overview: Subterranean excavation from Deck/GY, mineral and gem counter accumulation, energy charging, and explosive resource recovery.
